53 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, The idea: a policy beside the prompt {#idea}, The old problem: code and data in one channel {#code-and-data}…

So the layering I would want is simple to say. The vendor's policy, published, for what the platform does everywhere. The deployer's policy, on top, for what this agent in this business may do, with the business rules only the deployer can write. Each row marked with what enforces it, and each layer with an owner. That is the conversation I wantwould like to have with the vendors: not "add our text to your prompt", but what the policy should be, how it should exist, and who checks it, when we are giving an agent explicit guidance on how to behave across a whole business.
